dedupe_keys.name: global healthy and sustainable cities indicators tool

description: The Global Healthy and Sustainable Cities Indicators tool calculates urban spatial measures from open or user-provided data. Its current repository README lists population density, street connectivity, access to supermarkets, transit stops and public open space, and a walkability index. Users configure a city and input layers; outputs are indicators at point, small-grid and city scales, plus CSV tables, maps and reports. Geographic coverage is any supported city for which suitable source data exist. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the current code. A limitation is that indicators depend on input coverage, destination definitions and network routing; a measured 500-metre access score is not a simulation of future traveller choices. It can prepare urban service-access and active-mobility context for transport and public-facility scenarios. The related AequilibraE catalogue model handles network assignments, not these indicator calculations. No city dataset or app build was downloaded.
name: Global Healthy and Sustainable Cities Indicators tool
